verdict.rationale: Manufact's publish-checklist audits cover protocol compliance, platform readiness, and end-to-end functional tests (manufact-docs-7, manufact-docs-8), but there is no evidence these checks screen for malicious behavior or security vulnerabilities in listed servers before agent use. Missing for 10: any documented security/malware scanning step, vulnerability detection, or a curated registry vetting process distinct from functional/protocol compliance testing.
